name: MacEwan Law Club
tagline: Where MacEwan's future lawyers find their start.
intro: We are an enthusiastic collective of students providing networking opportunities for all students who are eager to jumpstart a career in the legal industry.
description: The MacEwan University Law Club: speaker nights, LSAT prep, networking and mock trials for MacEwan students curious about law.
joinBlurb: Membership runs through MacEwan's Campus Labs. It takes about two minutes with your MacEwan login.

standFor.intro: We strive to connect students with legal professionals, build community and leadership, and offer hands-on learning through shadowing opportunities.

pillars.title: Explore the legal field
pillars.body: Open discussions about the work of lawyers, paralegals, legal assistants and more.

pillars.title: See legal work up close
pillars.body: Shadow sessions that give students a taste of day-to-day legal work.

pillars.title: Connect and prepare
pillars.body: Panel discussions, Meet the Firm, Mock LSATs and application assistance days.

pillars.title: Fellowship and leadership
pillars.body: A community where students support each other and grow as leaders.

mission.statement: We strive to create a welcoming, all-inclusive environment to provide students with the necessary resources to better prepare for their future in the legal world.
mission.body: We connect students with legal professionals, build community and leadership, and offer hands-on learning through shadowing opportunities.

advisor.name: Professor Mahan Ashouri
advisor.department: Assistant Professor, International Business, Marketing, Strategy and Law
advisor.bio: Professor Ashouri is an assistant professor of law who focuses on business law, international trade, international arbitration and the law of economic sanctions. He studied law at the University of Tehran and earned master's degrees in law from the University of Richmond and McGill University, where he also did his doctoral studies. Before joining MacEwan, he taught legal research and international dispute resolution at McGill and founded the McGill International Business and Trade Law Society.
